title: RAG-NIMBF: A Non-Invasive, Modular Benchmarking Framework for Automated RAG Configuration Analysis
title_zh: 总结:RAG-NIMBF：一个用于自动化RAG配置分析的非侵入式模块化基准测试框架

paragraphs.en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has become the dominant paradigm for grounding the outputs of large language models (LLM) in external knowledge. However, practitioners are faced with a vast configuration space comprising chunking, embedding, retrieval, reranking, prompting and generation models, and there is limited guidance on how these components interact. We present RAG-NIMBF, a modular benchmarking framework that attaches to existing RAG pipelines as a non-invasive evaluation layer. It evaluates the configuration space through controlled ablation with end-to-end experiment tracking and is publicly available via GitHub. 1 1 1 https://github.com/aiengineeringblueprints/RAG-NIMBF The evaluation combines LLM-based answer quality scores, retrieval correctness measures, and runtime indicators. This study validates the framework across multiple generation models on the SQuAD dataset. This process reveals non-obvious interactions and demonstrates how the experiments are tracked. The findings indicate that the retrieval balance of relevance and diversity substantially enhances the relevance and coverage of retrieved context in comparison to a conventional similarity search, with MMR raising nDCG@5 by +4 to +11 percentage points across the swept models. More detailed prompt instructions meaningfully increase how faithfully generated answers stick to the retrieved evidence, especially for capable and reasoning models (+10 to +13pp on Qwen3.6-27B, GPT-4o-mini and Qwen3.5-think, but negligible on the 20B generator). Larger generation models improve answer quality at the cost of higher latency, yet the local Qwen3.6-27B matches GPT-4o-mini at mean faithfulness 0.89, and the frontier reference does not dominate the smaller generators on RAG-relevant metrics. Overall, RAG-NIMBF transforms the configuration space of RAG into reproducible, comparable experiments. By attaching to existing production pipelines in a non-invasive way, it enables practitioners to systematically evaluate and improve deployed systems without disrupting existing workflows. This replaces ad hoc choices with evidence-based decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）已成为将大语言模型（LLM）的输出锚定于外部知识的主流范式。 然而，实践者面对着一个由分块、嵌入、检索、重排、提示和生成模型组成的庞大配置空间，而关于这些组件如何相互作用的指导十分有限。 我们提出了 RAG-NIMBF，一个模块化的基准测试框架，它以非侵入式评估层的形式附加到现有 RAG 流水线上。 它通过受控消融实验评估该配置空间，并提供端到端的实验追踪，且已通过 GitHub 公开发布。1 1 1 https://github.com/aiengineeringblueprints/RAG-NIMBF 该评估结合了基于 LLM 的答案质量评分、检索正确性度量和运行时指标。 本研究在 SQuAD 数据集上跨多个生成模型对该框架进行了验证。 这一过程揭示了非显而易见的交互作用，并展示了实验是如何被追踪的。 研究结果表明，与传统的相似度搜索相比，在检索中平衡相关性与多样性能够显著提升检索上下文的相关性和覆盖范围，在被遍历的模型上，MMR 使 nDCG@5 提升了 +4 到 +11 个百分点。 更详细的提示指令能够显著提高生成答案对检索证据的忠实度，尤其是对能力强和具备推理能力的模型（在 Qwen3.6-27B、GPT-4o-mini 和 Qwen3.5-think 上提升 +10 到 +13 个百分点，但对 20B 生成模型的影响可以忽略）。 更大的生成模型能提升答案质量，但代价是更高的延迟；然而本地部署的 Qwen3.6-27B 在平均忠实度 0.89 上与 GPT-4o-mini 相当，且该前沿参考模型在 RAG 相关指标上并未全面优于较小的生成模型。 总体而言，RAG-NIMBF 将 RAG 的配置空间转化为可复现、可比较的实验。 通过以非侵入方式附加到现有生产流水线，它使实践者能够系统地评估和改进已部署的系统，而不干扰现有工作流程。 这用基于证据的决策取代了临时性的选择。

paragraphs.en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) [ 18 ] has emerged as the standard architecture for building knowledge-grounded question-answering systems. Rather than relying solely on parametric knowledge stored in model weights, RAG pipelines retrieve relevant documents from an external corpus and condition answer generation on the retrieved context. This approach reduces hallucination [ 32 ] and enables domain-specific applications without costly fine-tuning.
paragraphs.zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）[18] 已成为构建以知识为基础的问答系统的标准架构。 RAG 流水线并非仅依赖存储在模型权重中的参数化知识，而是从外部语料库中检索相关文档，并基于检索到的上下文来生成答案。 这种方法减少了幻觉 [32]，并且无需代价高昂的微调即可支持特定领域的应用。

paragraphs.en: A production RAG pipeline involves multiple interacting components:
paragraphs.zh: 生产级 RAG 管道涉及多个相互作用的组件：

paragraphs.en: A chunking strategy splits source documents into retrievable segments.
paragraphs.zh: 分块策略将源文档拆分为可检索的片段。

paragraphs.en: An embedding model maps chunks and queries to a shared vector space.
paragraphs.zh: 嵌入模型将文本块和查询映射到一个共享的向量空间。

paragraphs.en: A retrieval method selects the most relevant chunks.
paragraphs.zh: 检索方法会选择最相关的文本块。

paragraphs.en: A prompt template frames the generation task.
paragraphs.zh: 提示模板用于框定生成任务。

paragraphs.en: A generation model produces the final answer [ 9 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 生成模型产出最终答案 [ 9 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Each component offers multiple design choices resulting in a large combinatorial configuration space. Even small changes in chunk size, retrieval strategy, or prompt wording can shift faithfulness scores by more than ten percentage points [ 6 ] . However, practitioners often select configurations based on intuition, vendor claims, or community defaults rather than systematic evaluations against their own data [ 8 , 31 ] , and such defaults are highly sensitive to corpus and model [ 1 , 28 ] . For smaller organisations, building RAG on consumer-grade hardware rather than dedicated GPU clusters is the only economically viable path [ 33 ] , so this study covers models that run on such hardware. Although several evaluation frameworks exist [ 8 , 31 , 30 ] , their primary focus is on scoring a given pipeline rather than treating the configuration itself as the object of study. Systematic sweeps, component-interaction analysis, and reproducibility tracking are typically out of scope, and none of them are compatible with existing RAG pipelines.
paragraphs.zh: 每个组件都提供多种设计选择，从而形成一个庞大的组合配置空间。 即使是分块大小、检索策略或提示词措辞的微小变化，也可能使忠实度分数变动超过十个百分点 [ 6 ] 。 然而，从业者往往基于直觉、厂商宣称或社区默认值来选择配置，而不是针对自己的数据进行系统性评估 [ 8 , 31 ] ，且这些默认值对语料库和模型高度敏感 [ 1 , 28 ] 。 对于较小的组织而言，在消费级硬件而非专用 GPU 集群上构建 RAG 是唯一经济上可行的路径 [ 33 ] ，因此本研究涵盖可在此类硬件上运行的模型。 尽管已有若干评估框架 [ 8 , 31 , 30 ] ，但它们的主要焦点是对给定流水线进行打分，而非将配置本身作为研究对象。 系统性遍历、组件交互分析和可复现性追踪通常不在其范围之内，且它们均与现有 RAG 流水线不兼容。

paragraphs.en: These issues are addressed by RAG-NIMBF (RAG-Non-Invasive Modular Benchmarking Framework), a framework which is designed around three core principles:
paragraphs.zh: 这些问题由 RAG-NIMBF（RAG-非侵入式模块化基准测试框架）解决，该框架围绕三个核心原则设计：

paragraphs.en: Non-invasive integration: The framework wraps existing RAG components without modifying model or retriever internals. It connects to Ollama and OpenAI compatible endpoints (vLLM, TGI, …) through provider routing, requiring only model identifier strings and access data.
paragraphs.zh: 非侵入式集成：该框架在不修改模型或检索器内部实现的情况下，对现有 RAG 组件进行封装。 它通过提供者路由连接到 Ollama 以及兼容 OpenAI 的端点（vLLM、TGI 等），只需要模型标识符字符串和访问凭据。

paragraphs.en: Systematic configuration exploration: A declarative environment configuration specifies parameter ranges for all components. The framework generates the cartesian product and benchmarks every combination, producing and tracking structured results suitable for direct comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 系统化的配置探索：声明式环境配置为所有组件指定参数范围。 该框架生成笛卡尔积并对每种组合进行基准测试，生成并跟踪适合直接比较的结构化结果。

paragraphs.en: Hybrid evaluation: Each run is assessed through a combination of answer-quality, retrieval, generation, and runtime metrics, so that configuration effects can be inspected from multiple complementary angles.
paragraphs.zh: 混合评估：每次运行都通过答案质量、检索、生成和运行时指标相结合的方式进行评估，从而能够从多个互补的角度审视配置效果。

paragraphs.en: RAG-NIMBF is validated by benchmarking several configurations across different generation models spanning local, cloud-hosted, and API deployments on a 100-question sample from the SQuAD dataset [ 26 ] . Experiment tracking is built into the framework itself, with every run automatically logged in MLflow. This includes parameters, metrics, artifacts and traces, so the results reported here are fully reproducible without additional bookkeeping.
paragraphs.zh: RAG-NIMBF 的验证方式是，对多种配置进行基准测试，这些配置涵盖本地、云端托管和 API 部署等不同生成模型，并使用 SQuAD 数据集 [ 26 ] 的 100 个问题样本。 实验跟踪已内置于该框架本身，每次运行都会自动记录到 MLflow 中。 这包括参数、指标、工件和追踪信息，因此本文报告的结果无需额外的记录工作即可完全复现。

paragraphs.en: The following design choices materialise in three concrete contributions:
paragraphs.zh: 以下设计选择体现在三项具体贡献中：

paragraphs.en: A modular, non-invasive benchmarking framework for systematic RAG configuration analysis, with integrated MLflow tracking that makes every sweep reproducible by default.
paragraphs.zh: 一个模块化、非侵入式的基准测试框架，用于系统性的 RAG 配置分析，并集成了 MLflow 跟踪，使每一次参数扫描默认都可复现。

paragraphs.en: A hybrid evaluation methodology combining answer-quality, retrieval, and generation metrics with runtime measurements.
paragraphs.zh: 一种结合答案质量、检索与生成指标以及运行时测量的混合评估方法。

paragraphs.en: An empirical study revealing non-obvious interactions between chunking, retrieval, prompting, and generation components, with explicit focus on models that fit on consumer-grade hardware so that smaller organisations can adopt the findings without dedicated AI infrastructure.
paragraphs.zh: 一项实证研究，揭示了分块、检索、提示与生成组件之间非显而易见的交互作用，并特别关注可运行于消费级硬件上的模型，使小型组织无需专用 AI 基础设施即可采用这些研究成果。

paragraphs.en: Lewis et al. [ 18 ] introduced RAG by combining dense passage retrieval [ 14 ] with sequence-to-sequence generation. Subsequent systems have extended retrieval into pre-training, self-reflection, dynamic retrieval, graph-based reasoning and evidence checking [ 10 , 2 , 12 , 7 , 36 ] . Although surveys [ 9 ] demonstrate that output quality is affected by chunking, retrieval, and prompt design, they offer no tooling for the systematic comparison of configurations.
paragraphs.zh: Lewis 等人 [ 18 ] 通过将稠密段落检索 [ 14 ] 与序列到序列生成相结合，提出了 RAG。 后续系统将检索扩展到了预训练、自我反思、动态检索、基于图的推理以及证据核查 [ 10 , 2 , 12 , 7 , 36 ] 。 尽管综述 [ 9 ] 表明输出质量受分块、检索和提示词设计的影响，但它们并未提供用于系统性比较各种配置的工具。

paragraphs.en: Several frameworks evaluate a single pipeline configuration. RAGAS [ 8 ] introduced LLM-based metrics (faithfulness, answer relevance, context precision/recall). ARES [ 31 ] uses prediction-powered inference without gold references. RAGChecker [ 30 ] decomposes performance into retrieval and generation diagnostics. Chen et al. [ 6 ] benchmark LLMs on RAG but evaluate only model-level differences. Observability platforms such as LangSmith [ 16 ] and Langfuse [ 17 ] provide tracing and cost telemetry without Cartesian-product sweeps. However, none of these systems sweep the multi-component configuration space systematically.
paragraphs.zh: 多个框架只评估单一的流水线配置。 RAGAS [ 8 ] 引入了基于大语言模型的指标（忠实度、答案相关性、上下文精确率/召回率）。 ARES [ 31 ] 使用预测驱动推断，无需黄金参考答案。 RAGChecker [ 30 ] 将性能分解为检索与生成的诊断。Chen 等人 [ 6 ] 对大语言模型在 RAG 上进行了基准测试，但仅评估模型层面的差异。 LangSmith [ 16 ] 和 Langfuse [ 17 ] 等可观测性平台提供追踪与成本遥测，但不支持笛卡尔积式的全面扫描。 然而，这些系统均未系统性地扫描多组件配置空间。

paragraphs.en: A second class provides end-to-end RAG frameworks. LangChain [ 5 ] focuses on application composition rather than evaluation. FlashRAG [ 13 ] provides a modular toolkit comprising retrievers, generators, datasets, and a benchmark runner over preset configurations. However, it adopts an opinionated in-framework pipeline, meaning components must conform to its abstractions. Furthermore, evaluation couples neither IR, NLG, nor runtime indicators under a single non-invasive layer. DSPy [ 15 ] optimises prompt/few-shot choices within a configured pipeline rather than enumerating the Cartesian space. CRUD-RAG [ 22 ] contributes a Chinese-language benchmark over fixed pipelines. BERGEN [ 27 ] benchmarks retrieval and reader modules under fixed generation pipelines, but does not consider chunking, prompts, or runtime. RAGPerf [ 19 ] profiles production-like latency and throughput but does not enumerate the configuration space or couple IR/NLG with runtime.

paragraphs.en: By contrast, RAG-NIMBF is designed as a non-invasive evaluation layer that wraps existing components using provider routing. It treats every pipeline stage as a swept dimension and fuses RAGAS-based quality, IR, NLG, and runtime metrics under MLflow-tracked runs, leaving the host pipeline intact.
paragraphs.zh: 相比之下，RAG-NIMBF 被设计为一个非侵入式的评估层，通过提供者路由包装现有组件。 它将流水线的每个阶段视为一个被扫描的维度，并在 MLflow 跟踪的运行中融合基于 RAGAS 的质量指标、IR、NLG 以及运行时指标，同时保持宿主流水线不受影响。

paragraphs.en: RAG-NIMBF treats the configuration of a RAG pipeline, not the pipeline itself, as the object of study. Given a declarative specification of parameter ranges, it runs the cartesian product of all combinations and evaluates each run with a hybrid metric suite, leaving the host pipeline intact.
paragraphs.zh: RAG-NIMBF 将 RAG 流水线的配置而非流水线本身作为研究对象。 给定参数范围的声明式规范，它会运行所有组合的笛卡尔积，并用混合指标套件评估每次运行，同时保持宿主流水线不变。

paragraphs.en: The design was guided by three principles:
paragraphs.zh: 该设计遵循三项原则：

paragraphs.en: Non-invasive integration: components are addressed through model-identifier strings and provider routing, so existing RAG setups attach without modifying model or retriever internals..
paragraphs.zh: 非侵入式集成：组件通过模型标识符字符串和提供者路由进行寻址，因此现有的 RAG 设置无需修改模型或检索器的内部结构即可接入。

paragraphs.en: Systematic configuration exploration: an exhaustive cartesian sweep instead of surrogate-based search, so interaction effects across stages remain observable.
paragraphs.zh: 系统化配置探索：采用穷举式的笛卡尔扫描而非基于代理模型的搜索，从而保持跨阶段的交互效应可被观察。

paragraphs.en: Hybrid evaluation: RAGAS, IR, NLG, and runtime metrics are logged jointly to MLflow, so no single score can be optimised in isolation.
paragraphs.zh: 混合评估：RAGAS、IR、NLG 和运行时指标会联合记录到 MLflow 中，因此任何单一分数都无法被孤立地优化。

paragraphs.en: RAG-NIMBF’s pipeline proceeds through six stages, configuration, data loading, chunking, retrieval, generation, and evaluation, each implemented as an independent module. Figure 1 shows the overall data flow, a declarative configuration drives every downstream stage, intermediate artifacts (chunks, vector indices, retrieved contexts) are cached for reuse across configurations, and all parameters and metrics are logged to MLflow.
paragraphs.zh: RAG-NIMBF 的流程分为六个阶段：配置、数据加载、分块、检索、生成和评估，每个阶段均实现为独立模块。 图 1 展示了整体数据流：声明式配置驱动所有下游阶段，中间产物（分块、向量索引、检索到的上下文）会被缓存以便在不同配置间复用，所有参数和指标均记录到 MLflow 中。

paragraphs.en: The framework reads all parameters from a single environment file. Users specify comma-separated lists for each sweepable parameter and the framework computes their cartesian product. The framework supports sweepable generation models, chunking strategies, chunk sizes, overlap, retrieval method, top-k, prompt templates, HyDE, and reranking. We deliberately favour an exhaustive Cartesian sweep over more sample-efficient alternatives such as Bayesian optimisation or random search. Interaction effects across pipeline stages, for example chunk size against retrieval strategy or prompt template against model size, are the primary object of study. A surrogate-based optimiser would only reveal the best-performing point while leaving the interaction surface unobserved. The Cartesian product yields the full grid required for cross-configuration comparison and ablation. Model identifiers use provider:name syntax with automatic provider detection, e.g. ollama:qwen3:32b and openai:Qwen/Qwen3-32B-AWQ. A separate base URL can be configured per role, including generation LLM, critic LLM and embedding. This enables distributed setups and improves reproducibility by pinning each component to a fixed endpoint.
paragraphs.zh: 该框架从单个环境文件读取所有参数。 用户为每个可扫描参数指定以逗号分隔的列表，框架会计算它们的笛卡尔积。 该框架支持可扫描的生成模型、分块策略、块大小、重叠、检索方法、top-k、提示词模板、HyDE 以及重排序。 我们刻意选择穷举式笛卡尔扫描，而非贝叶斯优化或随机搜索等样本效率更高的替代方案。 流水线各阶段之间的交互效应，例如块大小与检索策略、提示词模板与模型规模之间的交互，是本研究的主要对象。 基于代理模型的优化器只会揭示表现最佳的点，而让交互面无从观测。 笛卡尔积产生跨配置比较与消融实验所需的完整网格。 模型标识符采用 provider:name 语法并自动检测提供方，例如 ollama:qwen3:32b 和 openai:Qwen/Qwen3-32B-AWQ。 可为每个角色单独配置基础 URL，包括生成 LLM、评论 LLM 和嵌入模型。 这使得分布式部署成为可能，并通过将每个组件固定到固定端点来提升可复现性。

paragraphs.en: A registry-based adapter pattern maps dataset identifiers to loading functions. Each adapter converts a HuggingFace dataset into a unified {question, ground_truth, context} format. Built-in adapters cover SQuAD [ 26 ] , RagBench, T2-RagBench, Ragas-WikiQA, and RagPerf-Wikipedia-NQ. For datasets with a shared corpus, documents are loaded once and reused across configurations.

paragraphs.en: The framework supports three chunking strategies via LangChain text splitters [ 35 ] :
paragraphs.zh: 该框架通过 LangChain 文本分割器 [ 35 ] 支持三种分块策略：

paragraphs.en: Recursive splitting with a separator hierarchy and a robust default for prose.
paragraphs.zh: 递归分割：使用分隔符层级结构，并为文本提供可靠的默认方案。

paragraphs.en: Fixed-size splitting using a token/character window with overlap and a deterministic baseline.
paragraphs.zh: 基于词元/字符窗口并带重叠的固定大小切分，采用确定性基线。

paragraphs.en: Semantic splitting using embedding-similarity breakpoints to preserve topical coherence.
paragraphs.zh: 使用嵌入相似度断点进行语义切分，以保持主题连贯性。

paragraphs.en: Sentence-aware, markdown-aware, and late chunking were considered but not adopted due to high variance on noisy text, no structural markup in the corpus and compute-heavy long-context requirements respectively. For semantic chunking, chunk size and overlap are ignored since boundaries are determined by embedding similarity.
paragraphs.zh: 句子感知切分、Markdown 感知切分和迟切分（late chunking）曾被考虑但未采用，原因分别是：在含噪文本上方差过高、语料中无结构化标记，以及长上下文带来的高计算开销。 对于语义切分，块大小（chunk size）与重叠（overlap）被忽略，因为边界由嵌入相似度决定。

paragraphs.en: Chunks are embedded and stored in ChromaDB or LanceDB. We chose these two over FAISS, Milvus, Qdrant, Weaviate, and pgvector for their local-first persistence, low operational cost, and sufficient scale for our evaluation. Vector stores are cached using content fingerprint keys, allowing index reuse across configurations that share the same chunking and embedding setup.
paragraphs.zh: 文本块会被嵌入向量化后存储到 ChromaDB 或 LanceDB 中。 相较于 FAISS、Milvus、Qdrant、Weaviate 和 pgvector，我们选择这两个数据库，是因为它们支持本地优先的持久化、运营成本低，并且其规模足以满足我们的评估需求。 向量存储通过内容指纹键进行缓存，使得在分块与嵌入配置相同的各个配置之间可以复用索引。

paragraphs.en: Retrieval supports similarity search ( k k nearest neighbours) and Maximal Marginal Relevance (MMR) [ 4 ] , which balances relevance with diversity through a tunable λ \lambda parameter. An optional HyDE step generates a hypothetical answer from the query and uses it as the retrieval input. An optional cross-encoder reranker re-scores retrieved documents and selects the top- n n for generation. Sparse/hybrid retrieval (BM25, dense+sparse fusion) is out of scope.
paragraphs.zh: 检索支持相似性搜索（ k k 近邻）和最大边际相关性（MMR）[ 4 ]，后者通过可调的 λ \lambda 参数在相关性与多样性之间进行平衡。 可选的 HyDE 步骤会从查询生成一个假设性答案，并将其用作检索输入。 可选的交叉编码器重排序器会对检索到的文档重新打分，并选出前 n n 个用于生成。 稀疏/混合检索（BM25、稠密+稀疏融合）不在本方案范围之内。

sents.en: An optional cross-encoder reranker re-scores retrieved documents and selects the top- n n for generation.

paragraphs.en: The framework routes requests to Ollama or OpenAI-compatible endpoints based on the model prefix. A wrapper normalises response formats for RAGAS compatibility. Answer post-processing strips <think> traces emitted by reasoning models before scoring, so that faithfulness reflects the final answer rather than intermediate chain-of-thought, keeping reasoning and non-reasoning models comparable under the same evaluation protocol.
paragraphs.zh: 该框架根据模型前缀将请求路由到 Ollama 或兼容 OpenAI 的端点。 一个包装器会对响应格式进行规范化，以兼容 RAGAS。 答案后处理会在评分前剥离推理模型输出的 <think> 思维痕迹，使忠实度反映最终答案而非中间思维链，从而让推理模型与非推理模型在同一评估协议下保持可比性。

paragraphs.en: Each configuration is evaluated through four complementary metric layers (Table 1 ).

paragraphs.en: Here, 𝒞 ans \mathcal{C}_{\text{ans}} denotes atomic claims in the answer, 𝒞 ctx \mathcal{C}_{\text{ctx}} the retrieved context, ℛ k \mathcal{R}_{k} the top- k k retrieved items, 𝒢 \mathcal{G} the gold items, and rel i \text{rel}_{i} the relevance grade of item i i . The RAGAS layer is computed by a separate critic LLM (Qwen3.5-397B-A17B, non-thinking mode) and measures answer quality against the retrieved context. The IR layer measures the quality of the retrieval against the gold passages in SQuAD and is therefore independent of the critic. The NLG layer measures surface-form similarity against the reference answer. The runtime layer records latency and throughput directly from the inference server. Reading the four layers jointly prevents any single metric from being gamed.
paragraphs.zh: 其中，𝒞 ans \mathcal{C}_{\text{ans}} 表示答案中的原子论断，𝒞 ctx \mathcal{C}_{\text{ctx}} 表示检索到的上下文，ℛ k \mathcal{R}_{k} 表示检索到的前 k k 个条目，𝒢 \mathcal{G} 表示黄金条目，rel i \text{rel}_{i} 表示条目 i i 的相关性等级。 RAGAS 层由一个独立的评审大语言模型（Qwen3.5-397B-A17B，非思考模式）计算，用于衡量答案相对于检索上下文的质量。 IR 层衡量检索相对于 SQuAD 中黄金段落的质量，因此与评审模型无关。 NLG 层衡量生成答案与参考答案在表层形式上的相似度。 运行时层直接从推理服务器记录延迟和吞吐量。 综合解读这四个层面可以防止任何单一指标被钻空子。

paragraphs.en: The largest open-weight model available to us, Qwen3.5-397B-A17B, an MoE with 397B total and 17B active parameters, is deliberately excluded from the generation sweep and reserved for the RAGAS critic role. Using the strongest available open model as the judge keeps evaluation quality uniform across configurations and avoids confounding generator quality with judge weakness. Running the critic on the same H100 cluster in non-thinking mode holds the evaluation harness fixed while the generators vary. DeepSeek-V4-Pro is included as a frontier reference but supports only similarity retrieval over its API, so it appears in the corresponding subset of the configuration space only.
paragraphs.zh: 我们可用的最大开放权重模型 Qwen3.5-397B-A17B（一种总参数量为 397B、激活参数量为 17B 的 MoE 模型）被有意排除在生成扫描之外，专用于 RAGAS 评估器的角色。 使用最强的可用开放模型作为评判者，可以在各种配置下保持评估质量的一致性，并避免生成器质量与评判者能力不足相互混淆。 在同一 H100 集群上以非思考模式运行评估器，可以在生成器各不相同的情况下保持评估框架固定不变。 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 作为前沿参考被纳入其中，但其 API 仅支持相似度检索，因此它只出现在配置空间中对应的子集里。

paragraphs.en: We use SQuAD [ 26 ] because it is a widely used extractive question-answering benchmark with gold passage supervision. This makes it possible to compute retrieval metrics (Hit@ k k , nDCG@ k k , Recall@ k k ) against a critic-independent ground truth while also evaluating generated answers against short reference answers. Its public availability and broad use in QA and RAG studies make the results easier to reproduce and compare to prior work.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 SQuAD [26]，因为它是一个被广泛使用的抽取式问答基准，具有黄金段落监督信号。 这使得我们能够基于与评审器无关的黄金标准计算检索指标（Hit@ k k、nDCG@ k k、Recall@ k k），同时还可以对照简短的参考答案评估生成的答案。 它的公开可得性以及在问答和 RAG 研究中的广泛使用，使研究结果更容易复现，也更容易与已有工作进行比较。

paragraphs.en: RAGAS metrics (faithfulness, context recall, semantic similarity) are computed using Qwen3.5-397B-A17B as the critic model with a maximum of 4096 critic tokens per evaluation call. IR metrics (Hit@ k k , nDCG@ k k , Recall@ k k for k ∈ { 1 , 3 , 5 } k\in\{1,3,5\} ) are computed against gold document labels provided by the SQuAD dataset. NLG metrics use RoBERTa-large for BERTScore [ 37 ] and standard implementations for METEOR [ 3 ] , ROUGE-L [ 20 ] , and BLEU [ 25 ] . All metrics are reported as means over the 100-question sample, with per-question values retained for the bootstrap and significance analyses reported in Section 5 .

paragraphs.en: Three models share the top mean faithfulness at 0.89 (GPT-4o-mini, Qwen3.6-27B, and the reasoning-only Qwen3.5-think at 0.88), with Qwen3-32B and GPT-OSS-20B trailing at 0.83 and 0.77. The best single configuration reaches up to 0.96 faithfulness (GPT-4o-mini), and 0.95 is attained by Qwen3.5-think and Qwen3.6-27B, showing that strong grounding is attainable across architectures and parameter budgets. paragraphs.en: The retrieval and prompt comparisons below use the five-model subset with full coverage of the swept configuration space. Table 5 compares similarity search and MMR on this subset. MMR improves nDCG@5 by +4 to +11pp by reducing redundancy in the retrieved set, with the largest gains on GPT-4o-mini (+11pp, 0.68 → 0.79 0.68\rightarrow 0.79 ) and Qwen3.5-think (+10pp, 0.70 → 0.80 0.70\rightarrow 0.80 ), and the smallest on GPT-OSS-20B (+4pp). The faithfulness effect reverses sign with model size, the two smaller generators Qwen3-32B (+5pp) and GPT-OSS-20B (+6pp) gain faithfulness under MMR, while GPT-4o-mini ( − 4 -4 pp), Qwen3.5-think ( − 2 -2 pp) and Qwen3.6-27B ( − 1 -1 pp) lose some. paragraphs.en: Four combinations, namely 500/100, 500/200, 1000/100, and 1000/200, were tested on Qwen3-32B with recursive chunking. paragraphs.en: The primary contribution of this work is RAG-NIMBF, a non-invasive benchmarking layer for systematically evaluating configurations across the RAG configuration space. Empirical findings suggest that the framework can help identify meaningful effects across pipeline stages, offering insights into the behaviour of different RAG configurations on consumer-grade hardware.
paragraphs.zh: 本文的主要贡献是 RAG-NIMBF，一种非侵入式的基准测试层，用于系统地评估 RAG 配置空间中的各种配置。 实验结果表明，该框架有助于识别不同流水线阶段中的显著效应，为不同 RAG 配置在消费级硬件上的行为提供洞察。

paragraphs.en: As RAG-NIMBF sweeps through every stage of the pipeline rather than fixing any component, the relative weight of each lever becomes apparent. The retrieval strategy and prompt wording can increase faithfulness and nDCG@5 by up to 11 percentage points, whereas the chunk size and overlap stay within 2-5 points. Interactions matter too, detailed prompts have almost no effect on GPT-OSS-20B but add +11 points on GPT-4o-mini. MMR reverses its faithfulness effect across model sizes.
paragraphs.zh: 由于 RAG-NIMBF 扫描流水线的每个阶段而非固定某个组件，各调节手段的相对权重便一目了然。 检索策略和提示词措辞可使忠实度和 nDCG@5 提升最多 11 个百分点，而块大小和重叠度的提升则在 2-5 个百分点之间。 交互效应也很重要：详细提示词对 GPT-OSS-20B 几乎没有影响，但在 GPT-4o-mini 上可带来 +11 个百分点的提升。 MMR 的忠实度效应在不同模型规模下会出现反转。

paragraphs.en: At fixed compute, the levers fall out of the sweep in a clear order. Prompting is the lowest-integration lever on capable models. Retrieval comes next, as measured by MMR’s nDCG@5 gains. Chunk size and overlap have smaller effects. Once these are set, the generator can be scaled appropriately. In our sweep, Qwen3.6-27B is a reasonable substitute for the tested cloud APIs.

paragraphs.en: This paper presents RAG-NIMBF, a non-invasive, modular benchmarking framework for systematic RAG configuration analysis. Across the swept SQuAD configurations, prompt specificity had the strongest effect on faithfulness, MMR improved retrieval coverage, and chunk-size effects were secondary. The results show why RAG configurations must be evaluated with multiple metrics: lexical scores, semantic similarity, retrieval quality, and runtime can move in different directions. Runtime measurements indicate that Qwen3.6-27B-NVFP4 can match GPT-4o-mini on mean faithfulness at lower latency, while the frontier reference model does not dominate on RAG-relevant metrics. Future work will extend the sweep to additional datasets, reranking, HyDE, and embedding models, and align RAG-NIMBF with on-premises enterprise RAG architectures such as the Weeger et al. blueprint [ 34 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了 RAG-NIMBF，一个用于系统性 RAG 配置分析的非侵入式模块化基准测试框架。 在所扫描的 SQuAD 配置中，提示词的具体程度对忠实度的影响最大，MMR 提升了检索覆盖率，而分块大小的影响是次要的。 结果表明为什么必须用多个指标来评估 RAG 配置：词汇得分、语义相似度、检索质量和运行时间可能朝不同方向变化。 运行时间测量表明，Qwen3.6-27B-NVFP4 能在更低延迟下达到与 GPT-4o-mini 相当的平均忠实度，而该前沿参考模型在 RAG 相关指标上并不占优。 未来工作将把扫描扩展到更多数据集、重排序、HyDE 和嵌入模型，并使 RAG-NIMBF 与 Weeger 等人蓝图 [ 34 ] 等本地部署的企业级 RAG 架构保持一致。
